fullTextEN: Do you dare to drink this thing?

fullTextZH: 在台湾，很多人生病的时候都喝这个。
fullTextEN: In Taiwan, many people drink this when they are sick.
I am Xika from Taiwan.
How are you?
Welcome to lazy Chinese.

fullTextZH: 今天我要告诉你在台湾一个治病的方法。
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell you about a method to cure illness in Taiwan.
This method is very special.

fullTextZH: 在台湾，很多人生病的时候都喝这个。
fullTextEN: In Taiwan, many people drink this when they are sick.
What is this?
This is a bowl of water.
The black thing inside,
was originally a piece of paper.
It's called talisman paper.
Talisman paper.
Burn it with fire,
After burning, add water.
This is talisman water.

fullTextZH: 现在你知道这是什么了。
fullTextEN: Now you know what this is.
Talisman water.
Do you dare to drink it?

fullTextZH: 为什么台湾人要喝符水呢？
fullTextEN: Why do Taiwanese people drink talisman water?
Because Taiwanese people,

fullTextZH: 特别是老一辈的台湾人，
fullTextEN: especially the older generation of Taiwanese people,

fullTextZH: 相信符纸有特别的力量。
fullTextEN: believe that talisman paper has special powers.

fullTextZH: 因为符纸上面写了符咒，
fullTextEN: Because talisman paper has spells written on it,
like this, with special characters written,
or special drawings made.
If you are sick,
or have nightmares while sleeping,

fullTextZH: 或是家里的小孩一直哭一直哭，
fullTextEN: or if the child at home keeps crying,
then you can go to the temple.
There are many temples in Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 你去庙里告诉庙里的人，说你有什么问题。
fullTextEN: You go to the temple and tell the people there what your problem is.
For example, you say a family member is sick.

fullTextZH: 那庙里的人会给你一张符纸。
fullTextEN: Then the people at the temple will give you a piece of talisman paper.

fullTextZH: 然后你回家把符纸烧了，
fullTextEN: Then you go home and burn the talisman paper,
add yin-yang water and drink it.
Drink it like this.
What is yin-yang water?
Yin water is cold water,
Unboiled cold water.
Yang water is boiled hot water.
You must want to ask, right?
Does this really work?
Will the illness be cured this way?
I also want to ask the same question.

fullTextZH: 很多台湾的年轻人也想问一样的问题。
fullTextEN: Many young people in Taiwan also want to ask the same question.

fullTextZH: 可是如果你告诉台湾的老人说符水很脏，
fullTextEN: But if you tell the elderly in Taiwan that the talisman water is dirty,
It's useless,
Don't drink it,
they will get angry.
There is a Taiwanese mother,
She took the baby to her mother-in-law's house.
Mother-in-law is the husband's mother.
Mother-in-law has a talisman paper,

fullTextZH: 是她去庙里用两万多块台币求来的。
fullTextEN: She got it from the temple for over 20,000 NT dollars.

fullTextZH: 2 万多块台币差不多是 600 块美金。
fullTextEN: Over 20,000 NT dollars is about 600 US dollars.
Very expensive,
Extremely expensive.
Mother-in-law burned the talisman paper,
Add milk and give it to the baby to drink.
After this mother found out,
She was furious.

fullTextZH: 因为她觉得符水很脏有毒。
fullTextEN: Because she thinks the talisman water is dirty and toxic.

fullTextZH: 可是婆婆是希望宝宝能平安长大，
fullTextEN: But the grandmother hopes the baby can grow up safely,
and not get sick,
so she gives him talisman water to drink.
The grandmother really believes in this method.
Do you think the grandmother is wrong?
The older generation of Taiwanese people would say,
Drinking talisman water really works!

fullTextZH: 很多小宝宝本来一直哭，
fullTextEN: Many little babies used to cry constantly,

fullTextZH: 喝了符水以后都不哭了。
fullTextEN: but after drinking talisman water, they stopped crying.

fullTextZH: 其实可能是因为符纸上有一个东西叫朱砂。
fullTextEN: Actually, it might be because there's something called cinnabar on the talisman paper.

fullTextZH: 庙里的人用朱砂画符纸，
fullTextEN: People in the temple use cinnabar to draw talisman paper,
which is this red area.

fullTextZH: 朱砂可以让人安静下来，
fullTextEN: Cinnabar can calm people down,
so they don't cry or make noise.
But cinnabar is also toxic,
and eating a lot can make you sick.

fullTextZH: 所以现在在台湾不可以用朱砂了。
fullTextEN: So now in Taiwan, cinnabar cannot be used.

fullTextZH: 现在你猜猜我喝不喝符水呢？
fullTextEN: Now, can you guess if I drink talisman water?
I don't drink it.
I don't want to drink this kind of thing.
But I asked my mom,
Did I drink talisman water when I was little?

fullTextZH: 她说我小时候喝过两次。
fullTextEN: She said I drank it twice when I was little.
When I was little, I cried all the time,
When I was crying all the time,

fullTextZH: 我的奶奶觉得可能我被鬼或其他可怕的东西吓一跳，
fullTextEN: My grandma thought maybe I was scared by ghosts or other scary things,
That's why I kept crying.
So she took me to the temple.
So I drank it twice.
I don't remember at all.

fullTextZH: 这就是在台湾的特别治病方法。
fullTextEN: This is a special treatment method in Taiwan.
What do you think?
This is a traditional method.
I think it's not scientific.

fullTextZH: 如果你生病了不想去看医生，
fullTextEN: If you are sick and don't want to see a doctor,
What method would you use?
Leave me a message.
See you next time.
Bye.
